text:
tara: Short daily  perf flake in staging. Need a tight cut for the public launch Fri. My proposal: MVP = conversational API + embeddings + billing hooks. Cut: per-tenant routing, admin dashboards, and long-term export. Thoughts?

noel: Agreed on core priorities. Quick note: per-tenant routing touches auth & gateway state; if we cut it QA can still integrate via a shim.

sophie: Infra impact: removing tenant routing drops memory p95 ~18% and avoids spinning a gateway node. Strong +1 for cut to keep latency stable.

liam: Product ops: if we cut dashboards we need a read-only debug endpoint for support. Low effort if feature-flagged. I can scope that.

ana: Sales: two prospects asked about routing. Offer a manual pilot (ops-enabled) as a compromise, with an ETA for v1 in the comms. They usually accept that.

scott: CTO: Proceed with cut. Guardrail: allow ops-assisted pilot for up to 2 named tenants, require DPA/sign-off before enabling. If canary p95 > 220ms post-cut we roll and delay launch.

noel: I'll open a small shim PR so QA continues to exercise routing flows: github.com/redwood/release/pull/1301 (ETA EOD).

sophie: I'll add automated alert for gateway memory and a rollback script: `ops/tools/disable-tenant-flag.sh` (target rollback < 15m).

liam: I'll update release notes + handbook: explicitly list deferred items and v1 timeline (target: 2 sprints). Draft: "Deferred: per-tenant routing, admin dashboards, long-term exports. Ops-assisted pilot available for strategic customers."

deploy-bot: deploy planned: branch release/2026-09-10 -> staging at 2026-09-08 04:00 UTC.

tara: Action items recap: 1) @noel shim PR, 2) @sophie alerts + rollback, 3) @liam comms + pilot process, 4) @ana collect pilot prospects. Locking scope now unless objections.

ana: I'll compile the two prospect names and route to Tara for pilot sign-off.

tara: Locking scope: conversational API + embeddings + billing hooks. Deferring routing/dashboards/exports to v1. Posting final note to handbook.
